QUOTE: "Rebuild if the index is older. If the index is newer, only restarting the client helps." and "The `schema` case where the index is newer than the server has no fix a consumer can take except restarting the client."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when the index is newer than the server (schema axis), a rebuild doesn't clear it. It also says the message tells the caller "a rebuild cannot clear it". It doesn't spell out the re-stamping mechanism, but the substance of the item is there.
